'''Kyobuk''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Merchant/Legends|merchant]] and [[Captain/Legends|captain]] who, along with her partner, the [[Advozse/Legends|Advozse]] [[Sars Tarquhar]], frequently operated on [[Bannistar Station]] during the reign of [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]].
